# Fische & mehr

> A small neighbourhood fishmonger and delicatessen in Vienna's 2nd district
> (Glockengasse 22, corner Novaragasse, 1020 Vienna, near Taborstraße). Fresh,
> frozen and smoked fish, live carp (Šaran) chosen from the tank and prepared to
> order, salmon caviar, and Russian and Eastern European delicacies. Not a
> supermarket, not e-commerce: no online prices or checkout; fish is daily produce.

## Facts
- Address: Glockengasse 22, 1020 Vienna, Austria (near Taborstraße station)
- Phone: 0676 844293203 (also WhatsApp)
- E-mail: angelina.refaelov@chello.at
- Opening hours: Monday–Friday 08:30–17:30; Saturday & Sunday closed
- Languages served: German (primary), English, Russian, Hebrew
- Live carp (Šaran) from the tank, cleaned, cut or minced on the spot
- Fresh & frozen fish: carp, gilt-head bream (dorade), sea bass (branzino), trout,
  salmon; also tuna fillet and steaks, tilapia, cod, pike-perch, silver carp, plaice,
  hake (Oslić) — whole or fillet, fresh or frozen depending on availability
- Preparation on request: scaling, gutting, cutting, filleting, mincing, vacuum-sealing
- Smoked fish and fillets; salmon caviar
- Delicacies: pickled cucumbers, tomatoes, peppers, cabbage, mushrooms, garlic;
  courgette purée, Georgian-style peppers, aubergines with peppers; Russian
  condensed milk, canned cod liver, sprats
- Ordering: in the shop, by phone or WhatsApp. No online payment.
